newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy drops to day's lows as Smith Barney sells.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy drops to day's lows as Smith Barney sells.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures tumbled to the day's lows as Smith Barney sold six million bushels November into the thinly traded market, traders said.
Fund selling extended losses in a market already weakened by a lower-than-expected export sales figures released early Thursday.
USDA pegged export sales in the week ended Oct. 3 at 582,400 tonnes, well below trade expectations of more than one million tonnes.
At 1023 CDT, soybeans were 1-1/4 to six cents per bushel lower with November down 4-3/4 at $7.33-1/2.
